overview.description: The Tuttle Capital Pure Play Photonics ETF (FOTO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in firms whose primary business operations are directly related to photonics. The fund focuses on businesses involved in technologies that generate, transmit, detect, and apply light across communications, sensing, imaging, manufacturing, and semiconductor applications. FOTO was launched on May 29, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital.

summary.post: . Holdings are typically published by the ETF issuer at the end of each trading day.

completeness: holdings are every published row of the issuer's own snapshot, all sharing one as_of_date that matches the payload's latest block and its published holdings_count
weights are the provider's signed values kept exactly as published, with derivative exposure legs and the cash line untouched and no sum-to-100 assertion
quantity keeps the publisher's own field with its literal label and an unknown unit, and market value is the publisher's own figure rather than a derived price
the security id is the row identifier and the security ticker is a symbol only when it is a plain ticker
country, sector and asset class are passed through as published and stay null when the issuer leaves them null
only the row named exactly 'CASH AND CASH EQUIVALENTS' is treated as the cash line; a null symbol alone is never read as cash

fund.name: Tuttle Capital Pure Play Photonics ETF
fund.investment_objective: The Fund seeks current income and long-term capital appreciation through focused exposure to photonics companies.
fund.strategy_blurb: Under normal conditions, at least 80% of the Fund's net assets are invested in equity securities of companies whose primary operations are directly related to photonics, including optical communications, silicon photonics, LiDAR, industrial lasers, optoelectronic devices, and related manufacturing. The Fund does not track an index.
